artworks.title: Mark
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure on a cloud writing on a tablet held in their left hand, with a quill in their right hand. The person has detailed facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in layered garments. A lion sits beside them. There are swirling clouds in the background, with rays of light behind the figure. There is an inscription in the top right corner reading "1539" with an emblem beneath it.

artworks.title: Luke
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length view of a seated man surrounded by clouds, with an animal, likely an ox, beside him. The man is positioned slightly angled to the left, with his head turned forward. He has long curly hair and a thick beard. His facial expression is serious, and he has prominent, deep-set eyes. He is dressed in a long, flowing robe that covers most of his body except for his bare feet, which rest on a cloud. In his hands, he holds an open book. There is no visible jewelry, but his presence is completed by the decorative folds of his garment. Behind him, a radiant halo of lines spreads outwards, and the background is filled with clouds. The top right corner has the numbers "1539" and a monogram resembling initials.

artworks.title: John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with a book and an eagle. The drawing depicts a robed figure with long, flowing hair, kneeling on a cloud, looking upward, and holding an open book. An eagle stands beside the figure, peering towards the book. The backdrop features swirling clouds with another figure visible in the top right corner. The composition is carefully balanced, with a bright halo surrounding the main figure's head.

artworks.title: Jason and Medea
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted. One is a standing warrior, while the other is a seated woman. The warrior is depicted in armor and holding a statuette of a soldier. The woman is reaching up towards the statuette with a contemplative expression. She is partially draped in fabric with her upper body exposed, has long wavy hair, wears a beaded necklace, and is surrounded by cylindrical objects. The background includes architectural elements and a textured wall.

artworks.title: Rhea Silvia
artworks.description: This print shows a nude woman standing next to a tree on the right. Her body faces us, and her head is turned, with her gaze directed to the right. The woman has long, cascading wavy hair that flows down her back and shoulders, and she has a long nose, thin eyebrows, large eyes, and small lips. Next to the woman, on the left, a nude man carries two children in his arms. The man appears to be walking, with one leg in front of the other. His wavy hair extends behind his head. Surrounding them is a natural setting, featuring a thick, textured tree trunk on the right and a landscape in the distance with faint outlines of hills and a building structure with pointed towers. On the far left, a distant person can be seen, also holding a child. There is an inscription above the scene in the top left corner of the print.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola
artworks.description: The image features three figures in an architectural setting. In the center, a muscular male figure stands in a powerful pose. To the left, a seated individual looks up at him, covered in draped cloth. To the right, another muscular figure, wearing a crown, is seated on a cushioned chair, gesturing with one hand. The background includes arches, columns, and buildings. The style of the drawing indicates proficiency in depicting human anatomy and classical themes.

artworks.title: Titus Manlius Beheading His Son
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting medieval armor and a guillotine-like structure. The drawing showcases a dramatic composition filled with intricate details. In the foreground, a robust armored figure stands prominently next to a vertically oriented wooden structure. Behind and to the sides, elements such as spears and swords create a dense backdrop along with soldiers in armor. The artistry focuses on creating depth and texture through cross-hatching and fine lines, characteristic of detailed engravings or etchings. The entire scene evokes a sense of historical narrative and confrontation.

artworks.title: The Severe Father
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with two figures. One figure is depicted as an older, muscular person in a bed, gripping the other by the hair. The second figure is clothed and partly on the ground, looking shocked. The bed is elaborately furnished with a large pillow and a draped canopy. There is a cartouche at the top with Latin text and a signature and date at the bottom left indicating the drawing was made in 1553. The style and technique suggest a highly detailed, Renaissance-inspired drawing with strong contrasts and detailed line work.

artworks.title: Luna
artworks.description: The image shows a female figure standing in profile with her head turned slightly. She has soft facial features, long hair, and is wearing a beaded necklace. In one hand, she holds a circular object resembling a mirror, while the other holds onto a large piece of fabric. In the background, there is a detailed ship with sails, fortress-like structures, and two smaller figures with a large wheel beside them.

artworks.title: Hercules as a Child
artworks.description: This is a drawing containing a nude woman and a swan. The central figure is a nude woman with elaborate coiffed hair, holding a swan whose neck intertwines with hers. The swan's wings are prominently displayed. To the left, a young child reclines on a cloth-draped surface, interacting with serpents, while an elder child stands near. The background features architectural elements like columns, with a small framed depiction of a winged figure above them. The bottom of the drawing contains an inscription in Latin. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Hercules Slaying the Lion of Nemea
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man battling a lion. The drawing depicts a muscular, bearded figure holding an aggressive stance over a lion; his hands are around the lion's neck. The background shows a dense forest with a small building in the distance. Another smaller scene in the background portrays another similar confrontation with a lion. The composition is detailed with intricate lines and shading, adding texture and form to the figures and foliage. The bottom of the drawing includes ancient script.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing Cacus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a confrontation in a rocky landscape involving cattle. The drawing depicts a muscular figure standing over another figure on the ground, surrounded by cattle. The standing figure holds a knotted club and appears to be striking, while the recumbent figure lies defensively. In the background, another figure is leading a cattle into a cave in reverse direction. The scene is detailed with rocky textures, trees, and clouds casting shadows. The drawing showcases an intense narrative moment with dramatic action, set in a classical and mythic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Hercules Fighting with the Hydra of Lernea
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a human figure fighting a multi-headed creature. The human is on the left, wielding a club, and wearing a lion's pelt. The creature on the right has multiple heads and is in an aggressive pose. Dark textures are in the background, and skeletal remains are in the foreground. Latin text is at the bottom. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance printmaking.

artworks.title: Hercules and Cerberus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a male figure and a three-headed dog. The figure is unclothed and holds a chain that controls the three-headed dog. The setting is an ancient or mythical urban environment with stone buildings in the background. There is movement in the flowing hair and dynamic pose of both figures. Fine lines and hatching create detailed texture. Latin text is inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Hercules and Anthaeus
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded, muscular man holding a club, standing next to another muscular man with curly hair. In the background, there are rocky cliffs with castellated structures overlooking a town by the water.

artworks.title: Hercules Fighting the Rivergod Achelus
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a powerful figure standing over a defeated serpent-like creature. The scene shows a muscular figure holding another similarly muscular, bearded figure in a dynamic pose. The defeated creature lies on the ground, surrounded by stones and a spear. In the background, there is a detailed view of a town or settlement beside a body of water, with intricately detailed trees adding a natural element to the scene. The piece is rich in line work and texture.

artworks.title: Hercules Slaying the Dragon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure combatting a serpent-like creature. In the foreground, a bearded figure wielding a large club stands triumphantly over a dragon. The figure is depicted with exaggerated musculature and a draped cloak. The dragon lies defeated beneath him, with its mouth open, showing sharp teeth. In the background, a cylindrical stone tower rises, set against a landscape of hills and trees. The sky is depicted with line work indicating moving clouds. An inscription at the bottom provides an ancient text. The detailed engraving style emphasizes texture and form.

artworks.title: Hercules and Atlas
artworks.description: The image depicts two muscular, bearded figures. One holds a celestial sphere. The central figure is muscular and holding a large celestial globe on his shoulders. The second figure, draped in a cloth, stands beside him, gesturing towards the sphere. In the background, there is a miniature landscape with a small settlement by a body of water. The figures and objects are detailed with intricate lines and textures. This image is done in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Hercules Preventing the Centaurs from the Rape of Hippodamia
Hercules Killing Nessus
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a centaur, a nude figure, and another male figure holding a bow. The centaur is seated on the ground engaging with the figure on the right who holds a cloth. The male figure on the left stands holding a bow and sheathed sword. The background shows a cityscape and a textured sky. The image has detailed lines and shading, giving it depth and dimension. There is a Latin inscription below the scene.

artworks.title: Hercules Carrying the Two Columns of Gaza
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular man carrying two large columns over his shoulders. He is striding forward in a dynamic pose, with his right leg bent. The man's head is turned slightly towards the viewer, while his gaze is focused ahead. He has rugged facial features, a prominent nose, a beard, curly hair, and is dressed in minimal clothing with a fur or skin draped over his body. He is barefoot. In the background, there is another figure tending to an animal on the ground, a ship in the distance on the sea, and more standing columns in a rocky terrain with vegetation.

artworks.title: Hercules and the Hind
artworks.description: This print depicts a bare-chested man on top of a large deer, with the man's full body shown. He is positioned in a crouched manner with one foot against the deer's back, gripping its antlers tightly with both hands. He has a full beard and curly hair that covers much of his head, and his muscles are visible down his body. He wears no clothing except for a cloak draped over one shoulder. There appears to be an explosion occurring to the left, with erupting fire and smoke, and a human near it seems to be falling. In the background there are buildings in the distance, perhaps a city. The print includes text at the bottom, with the date "1550" and a monogram "AG" appearing on the upper right side.

artworks.title: Faith
artworks.description: The artwork shows a woman from the waist up, positioned in profile facing the right side of the image. Her right hand is on a wooden beam and her left hand holds a chalice. She has distinct features, including a strong nose, almond-shaped eyes, full lips, long curly hair flowing over her shoulders, and an ornate jewel-adorned headdress. She wears an elaborate gown with puffy sleeves, fur-lined neckline, and accessories such as a chain necklace and beaded jewelry. The background is textured with a wooden structure, two feet, and an inscribed panel on the top left corner with the date "1528" and an artist's monogram.

artworks.title: Three Musicians
artworks.description: Three men are depicted in full-length view, standing closely together and each holding a musical instrument resembling a small bagpipe. The man on the left has short, curly hair, the man in the middle has short hair with a slight part, and the man on the right has longer, wispy hair. Each man wears a long, loose-fitting cloak with folds visible in the fabric and what appear to be tights or stockings on their legs. They stand on a patch of ground with tufts of grass and small stones. The background is plain, focusing on the figures. In the upper right corner, there is a boxed area containing a date and initials.
